_comment: Documents ingested by `python -m app.ingest`. This file is the source of truth for
the `scheme`, `document` and `url` values that appear in cited_sources.
To ingest: download the official PDF, save it in corpus/pdfs/ under the exact
`source_pdf` filename below, set `document` to the title printed on the PDF
(including its year/revision) and `pdf_url` to the exact link you downloaded, then
run the ingest CLI. `url` is the citation link shown to the user, so it should be a
stable landing page rather than a deep link that rots.
First ingestion pass is PMEGP + MUDRA; the RBI MSME restructuring circular is
intentionally deferred, add it as a third entry when we pick it up.
